name: Authority Bias
definition: Status or authority is treated as sufficient grounds for accepting a claim.
boundary: Appropriate reliance on relevant expertise is not enough to establish bias.

source_variants.name: Authority Bias (Otorite yanlılığı)
source_variants.definition: Weighting a claim because it comes from an authority rather than examining its evidence.
source_variants.coverage_reason: No named mechanism, required state or observation model is implemented in the original Mesa sample.
